headline_marked: Home Minister says [[Awami League will never be able to do politics]] in Bangladesh
headline: Home Minister says Awami League will never be able to do politics in Bangladesh
summary: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed claims the party's political existence has been eradicated and will face legal trials for its actions.
details: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that the Awami League has suffered a total political collapse and will never be able to engage in politics within Bangladesh again.
Speaking at the July National Conference at the China-Bangladesh Friendship Conference Center in Dhaka on Saturday, he asserted that the party's political existence has been 'buried in Delhi'.
The Minister noted that investigations are ongoing and the party will soon be brought to the dock to face trial as a political entity, ensuring justice according to the law.

He criticized former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, claiming she shows no remorse for the genocide committed during the July uprising and is instead conspiring against the current democratic government from abroad.
Salahuddin Ahmed also alleged that those who previously spoke of the spirit of the liberation war have now fled to Delhi and warned against those attempting to profit from the 'July spirit'.
The Minister further revealed that he and Tarique Rahman were in exile during the uprising, claiming their coordination of BNP activists behind the scenes helped ensure the success of the movement.
caption:
The Awami League will never return to politics in Bangladesh, claims Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed.

Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that the Awami League has suffered a total political collapse and will never be able to engage in politics within Bangladesh again.

Speaking at the July National Conference at the China-Bangladesh Friendship Conference Center in Dhaka on Saturday, he asserted that the party's political existence has been 'buried in Delhi'.

The Minister noted that investigations are ongoing and the party will soon be brought to the dock to face trial as a political entity, ensuring justice according to the law.

He criticized former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, claiming she shows no remorse for the genocide committed during the July uprising and is instead conspiring against the current democratic government from abroad.

Salahuddin Ahmed also alleged that those who previously spoke of the spirit of the liberation war have now fled to Delhi and warned against those attempting to profit from the 'July spirit'.

The Minister further revealed that he and Tarique Rahman were in exile during the uprising, claiming their coordination of BNP activists behind the scenes helped ensure the success of the movement.

headline: Argentina, Colombia, Egypt clinch final berths for World Cup Round of 16
summary: Defending champions Argentina survived a major scare against Cape Verde to secure their spot in the knockout stages of FIFA World Cup 2026.
details: The Round of 32 of the FIFA World Cup 2026 concluded on Saturday morning, with Argentina, Colombia, and Egypt securing the final three spots in the Round of 16.
Defending champions Argentina edged out tournament debutants Cape Verde in a thrilling 3-2 victory, narrowly avoiding a major upset.
Colombia advanced with a hard-fought 1-0 win over Ghana, while Egypt eliminated Australia in a penalty shootout following a 1-1 draw.
The Round of 16 begins tonight with hosts Canada facing Morocco, followed by a match between Paraguay and France.
Other high-profile fixtures include Brazil against Norway and Portugal versus Spain.
In a highly anticipated clash, defending champions Argentina will face Egypt in the next round.
caption:
Argentina survives a major scare! 🇦🇷

The defending champions and two other teams have just booked their final tickets to the World Cup Round of 16.

The Round of 32 of the FIFA World Cup 2026 concluded on Saturday morning, with Argentina, Colombia, and Egypt securing the final three spots in the Round of 16.

Defending champions Argentina edged out tournament debutants Cape Verde in a thrilling 3-2 victory, narrowly avoiding a major upset.

Colombia advanced with a hard-fought 1-0 win over Ghana, while Egypt eliminated Australia in a penalty shootout following a 1-1 draw.

The Round of 16 begins tonight with hosts Canada facing Morocco, followed by a match between Paraguay and France.

Other high-profile fixtures include Brazil against Norway and Portugal versus Spain.

In a highly anticipated clash, defending champions Argentina will face Egypt in the next round.

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, Somoy News, The Daily Star
